records.title: Distance-KV: Exploiting Relative Distance for Efficient Long-Context Inference
records.reason: Distance-KV retains KV entries based on relative distance for long-context inference, reducing KV memory and improving speed.

records.title: Why and When Visual Token Pruning Fails? A Study on Relevant Visual Information Shift in MLLMs Decoding
records.reason: The abstract analyzes visual-token pruning failure in MLLM decoding and introduces a low-overhead pruning approach preserving relevant information; directly concerns inference token/pruning efficiency.

records.title: Model Training with Sparsity Loss for Compressed Attention
records.reason: The pinned stable IEEE DOI/title and official ICTAI program metadata identify the work, but the IEEE primary abstract could not be retrieved; the program exposes title/authors only. No title-only acceptance.

records.title: MoPEQ: Mixture of Mixed Precision Quantized Experts
records.reason: MoPEQ assigns mixed-precision quantization to MoE experts to reduce the memory footprint of quantized LLM experts.

records.title: Thinking with Drafts: Speculative Temporal Reasoning for Efficient Long Video Understanding
records.reason: Thinking with Drafts applies speculative temporal reasoning to long-video MLLM inference and reports faster generation/understanding.

records.title: PERK: Long-Context Reasoning as Test-Time Learning
records.reason: PERK's primary abstract uses test-time gradient updates in LoRA as a memory module for long-context reasoning and reports quality gains. It does not establish serving or inference-efficiency gains; the long-context/memory connection is indirect.

records.title: Self Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
records.reason: The abstract presents self-speculative decoding for diffusion LLMs, preserving output quality while accelerating inference.

records.title: Jina-OCR-v1: Efficient Document Parsing with Speculative Decoding and Dense Verifiable Rewards
records.reason: Jina-OCR-v1 uses speculative decoding for document parsing on constrained hardware and reports higher inference throughput; direct specialized inference efficiency.

records.title: Attention Once Is All You Need: Efficient Streaming Inference with Stateful Transformers
records.reason: Attention Once uses a persistent state and incremental prefill for streaming Transformer inference, reducing repeated attention work and enabling more concurrent sessions.
